title: Mushroom Cream Pan Sauce for Chicken
steps: Mushrooms. After cooking the chicken, heat the olive oil in the same pan and brown the mushrooms.*
Aromatics. Add butter, minced shallot, garlic and the herbs if using; cook until soft.*
Reduce. Add the stock and reduce by about half, scraping up the browned bits.*
Cream. Add the cream and simmer until it coats a spoon. Finish with parsley and chive and spoon over the chicken.*
notes: * The post lists only ingredients; the method is written from the listed ingredients and the reel, with no quantities added. The reel frame shows the cook more than the finished dish.
